# ABOUTME: Append-only: add keys, never edit or reorder a line, since history criteria find each key's commit by its line.
#
# compiled is compiled.txt's line count: the files perl -c accepts (with the
# shebang's taint switch), minus perl.git's perlRejects (comp/final_line_num.t).
# graded is the files the oracle sweep graded: the 594 non-excluded files less
# the runner errors (re/pat_psycho.t, at the 8m per-file budget).
# They are different sets of the same size; nothing compares them as one.
interpreter = 5.044000
compiled = 593
graded = 593
#
# faithful_start_all is internal/parse/testdata/perlgittfaithful.ratchet's
# "# N/619 faithful" N: perl.git t/ files whose canon emission says what the
# source says, under today's parse.Faithful. faithful_start_m3 is that
# ratchet's 0 rows under op/ mro/ uni/ lib/ test_pl/.
faithful_start_all = 342
faithful_start_m3 = 178
#
# rv2hv_wider is sites.txt's `total all rv2hv wider`: the whole corpus's
# wider rv2hv sites, with op/magic.t's sites still counted as no-answer.
# m3_exact_pct is the M3 dirs' exact share of their sites (3012 of 3365),
# recorded for the docs; the floor it is held to is the fixed 80%.
rv2hv_wider = 396
m3_exact_pct = 89.51
#
# rv2hv_wider_after_magic is sites.txt's `total all rv2hv wider` once the
# oracle answers op/magic.t: rv2hv_wider plus op/magic.t's 20 wider rv2hv
# sites, which had counted as no-answer. The arrow-read fix measures its
# fall from here; rv2hv_wider stays as the pin recorded it.
rv2hv_wider_after_magic = 416
#
# rv2hv_wider_after_arrow is sites.txt's `total all rv2hv wider` once
# Sites counts a `->{...}` chain's rv2hv by perl's multideref rule
# (01a12059-30a8): rv2hv_wider_after_magic less the arrow reads and
# computed keys it now decides.
rv2hv_wider_after_arrow = 399
